criteria.nemotron-ultra: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free. Strongest free model: hard reasoning, system design, planning, analysis. Slowest - only for genuinely hard tasks.
criteria.nemotron-lightning: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free. Fast everyday tasks that need more quality than the smallest models: high throughput, short contexts.
criteria.nemotron-vl: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free. Images and visual documents: screenshots, scans, charts, OCR, describing photos (vision).
criteria.longcat: LongCat 2.5 Preview Free. Very long context: analysing long documents, logs, many files at once.
criteria.minimax-flash: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free. Frontier multimodal coding model with tunable thinking depth: for tasks that need higher quality.
criteria.mimo-flash: MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free. Fastest flash class: short answers, simple automations, light text tasks.
criteria.beam: Beam Free. Sparse MoE (23B active params) for reasoning and agentic workflows: complex analysis and tool use.
criteria.big-pickle: Big Pickle. Deliberation model: multi-step analysis, problem solving and tool use.
criteria.or-free: Free Models Router. Automatic choice of a currently available free model via OpenRouter; when no clear favourite exists.
criteria.nim-nemotron-70b: Llama 3.1 Nemotron 70B Instruct. 70B model via your own NVIDIA NIM key: serious reasoning, analysis and code, beyond opencode free limits; no queues.
criteria.nim-glm-flash: GLM-5.3-Flash. Same profile as the free GLM Flash, via your own NIM key: stable, for tasks that cannot wait for the free endpoint.
criteria.nim-deepseek-flash: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Fast coding via your own NIM key: when the free opencode endpoint runs out.
criteria.qwen-local: Qwen 3.8 27B lokalnie (Ollama). Runs offline on the laptop, fully private. Short 8k context, slow on this machine. Note: must be pulled into Ollama first.
